page: OVHcloud d2-4 is an entry-level virtual server belonging to the Discovery family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Haswell processor with 2 vCPUs and 2 physical cores operating at 2.0 GHz. The CPU allocation is shared, and the processor includes 16 MB of L3 cache, 4 MB of L2 cache, and 32 KB of L1d cache. It supports AVX, AES, BMI2, and FMA instruction sets, but lacks AVX-512 capabilities. The system is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB per core, and includes 50 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark results position this server in the lower performance tier, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU scores falling into the bottom 10% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth is measured at 133.34 GB/sec for small cached blocks and drops to 19.19 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. In application-level benchmarks, the server achieves 2.07 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and a static web serving throughput of 1.89 GB/sec. Large language model inference on a small 135M model yields 122.58 tokens per second for prompt processing and 47.98 tokens per second for text generation.

Given its shared CPU allocation and modest hardware specifications, the d2-4 offers a highly cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require sustained high-performance compute resources. The inclusion of 50 GB of local NVMe SSD storage provides fast local read and write access relative to the compute tier. This server is best suited for lightweight, non-critical workloads such as development environments, basic web serving, small-scale testing, or low-traffic application hosting.
